visual.general_description: Grid of retinal OCT image pairs arranged by case (rows labelled 1 to 4, each split into Central and Inferior) and by time column (On previous treatment, At first faricimab, Unexpected response, Final visit).
visual.detailed_description: White header row prints "Case", "On previous treatment", "At first faricimab", "Unexpected response" and "Final visit". The left column prints case numbers 1, 2, 3 and 4, and each case is split into two rows rotated-labelled "Central" and "Inferior". Every populated cell holds two side-by-side images: a greyscale en face fundus image with a green-tinted overlay of fine horizontal scan lines and one thicker yellow-green horizontal line marking the scan position, and a grey OCT B-scan showing the layered retina. The Case 1 "On previous treatment" cells (central and inferior) are solid black with no image. In the Case 1, Case 3 and Case 4 inferior rows the B-scans in the "Unexpected response" column show a larger dome-shaped elevation beneath the retinal layers than the same case in the "At first faricimab" column; the Case 2 inferior "Unexpected response" B-scan shows a smaller dome. In the "Final visit" column the Case 1 and Case 3 inferior B-scans show a smaller or flat contour, while the Case 4 inferior B-scan still shows a large dome-shaped elevation with a dark internal lumen. The Case 3 inferior "At first faricimab" B-scan has a strongly curved shape. The B-scan images are different sizes between cells. Very small scanner text and scale marks sit in the corners of the images and are not legible.
